children.text: Compose typed transformations, preview actual generation and publish recoverable dataset runs.
Compose typed source, transform and generation steps. Preview bounded samples, review rejections, then publish through a recoverable worker job.

Three attempts are reserved per run. Previews generate at most three rows per step; full generation uses at most 32. Completed step and row checkpoints survive worker interruption. Privacy, deduplication and protected-source checks run before generation and publication.
Canonical sources exclude their complete source groups. Prepared manifests exclude validation/test groups.
I reviewed the matching preview and rejections.
